summary: Nintendo's Kid Icarus series began as a Famicom Disk System/NES action-platform game and is currently accessible through Nintendo's classic-game services.

primary.how_to_play: Use Kid Icarus through Nintendo Switch Online/Nintendo Classics. Record service/app version, region, suspend/rewind state, level, score/hearts, password/save state, difficulty, and whether FDS or 3D Classics was compared.
